# Workspace Policy Refresh Published: January 15, 2025
Published: January 15, 2025 The workspace policy refresh has three main goals: reduce operating cost, standardize hybrid work guidance across teams, and improve onboarding consistency for new hires.

The workspace policy refresh has three main goals: reduce operating cost, standardize hybrid work guidance across teams, and improve onboarding consistency for new hires. Managers must publish team schedules two weeks in advance.
